change.read: HttpPoolCyclePorts.read_strategy_specs reads GET /api/registry/strategy-specs?view=discovery_candidates&tenant_id=<persona tenant>&page_size=50[&page_token] (owner excludes retired/rejected in SQL and returns only registry_id, strategy_id, artifact_state, lineage, metadata). The unpaged GET /api/registry/strategy-specs is no longer issued from the cycle path.
change.projection: Each spec is reduced to HttpPoolCyclePorts.SCORER_SPEC_KEYS: the keys _candidate_from_strategy_spec and the demand pre-filter in persona_strategy_discovery.discover_for_demand read, plus strategy_spec_registry_id and lineage (carried before). Spec bodies such as signals/parameters/description are dropped after the page arrives.
change.owner_filter_or_projection_gap: none: the owner view supplies the retired/rejected filter and five-field projection; no block needed.

caps.time_budget_seconds_per_read: 30 (PERSONA_DISCOVERY_SPEC_BUDGET_SECONDS), checked before each page after the first
caps.reuse_seconds: 600 (PERSONA_DISCOVERY_SPEC_REUSE_SECONDS): one successful read per tenant serves every open demand and every persona of that tenant in the window

change.stop_conditions: no next_page_token (complete), page_cap, time_budget, page_failed:<Exc> after >=1 page (partial, keeps what was read), resumed_tail (a read that started from a resume cursor reached the end; it saw only the tail). A failed first page raises RuntimeError strategy_spec_read_unavailable:pages=0:specs=0:<Exc> and the demand is recorded discovery_unavailable.
change.coverage_across_cycles: a capped read stores the owner's next_page_token per tenant (in memory) and the next read resumes from it, so 8,019 visible hosted rows (161 pages) are covered in 5 reads; after the tail the next read starts from the beginning.
change.demand_record: every run whose specs were read by the port carries spec_read {specs_seen, pages, bytes, seconds, partial, stop_reason, resumed, max_pages, page_size, budget_seconds}; a partial read sets partial=true, specs_seen, spec_pages, spec_partial_reason, and with no match the reason is partial_spec_read:<n>_specs_seen_no_match_yet (a partial seed read reason is kept first). Never no_candidate_fits_persona / no_candidates_available for a partial read.
change.starvation: each persona's read is bounded by 40 pages and 30 s; a read failure is per demand and isolated (the next demand reads again, failures are not cached); personas of the same tenant reuse one read within 600 s.
change.seed_read: DISCOVERY-SEED-READ-BOUNDED-20261125 behaviour unchanged (same partial fields and partial_seed_read reason; test_partial_seed_read_is_recorded_as_partial_never_as_no_match passes).
change.tenant_and_credential: unchanged: same _call/transport, same PERSONA_REGISTRY_SERVICE_TOKEN bearer and X-Tenant-Id = persona tenant; tenant_id query = the same persona tenant (the owner rejects a mismatching header with 403).

tests.unpaged_guard: FakeRegistry.transport and the hosted-scale transport assert view=discovery_candidates on every registry request; any unpaged list from the cycle path fails the test. test_persona_demand_discovery's fake no longer answers the unpaged path (falls through to its AssertionError).
tests.equality: test_scoring_is_identical_to_the_previous_unpaged_read keeps the replaced function verbatim as _previous_read_strategy_specs and compares, over a recorded set (draft/approved/candidate, retired and rejected rows, metadata-level and spec-level mechanism/mechanism_status/mechanism_support, negative_memory_match warning and info, lineage with parent ids and execution_route, missing metadata/lineage, required_data and allowed_use): same registry ids in order, equal StrategyCandidate per spec, equal lineage/mechanism*/negative_memory_match/metadata, and equal discover_for_demand output for three demands (no filter, tried family, missing dataset) with max_matches 50.
